GraceRequirements.Annotation: Autonomous department-planning platform for documents, plans, calendar, assignments, meetings, reporting, evidence and controlled offline operation.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: offline-first, department planning, documents, SQLite, evidence, audit, ACL, migrations, GitHub CI, GRACE

Goals.Goal: Keep one authoritative domain record for each fact while derived calendar, search, report and notification projections remain rebuildable.
Deliver changes through a traceable branch, approved GRACE change contract, deterministic verification and reviewed merge into main.
Preserve documents, provenance, audit history and operational recoverability across upgrades and failures.

Users.User: Department staff, managers and administrators operating primarily on Debian/Astra Linux.
Maintainers and Codex agents implementing and releasing the application.

Constraints.Constraint: The primary product must work without Internet access, Docker, cloud services or an LLM.
LLM integration is optional and local; deterministic domain behavior remains authoritative.
Source documents and document versions are immutable; corrections create revisions and audit evidence instead of rewriting history.
Derived projections must not silently become a second source of truth.
Persisted changes must preserve ACL, provenance, transactionality and idempotency.
Significant repository changes require an approved active GRACE spec and plan before implementation.
